reviews.changes: Thursday CX now has targets: race 1 is the session, first lap no faster than the average of the others, HR 155+ from lap 2, lap-average 150+; race 2 easy or skip. It counts as the week's VO2 only if those are hit. Week 8 (recovery): one race only. Gear: keep 40x20; its ~60 rpm race cadence is useful torque work.

All past gym days marked done. Week 5 Thursday is now easy Z2 (no CX race, no VO2): after a fever, high intensity waits until fully symptom-free. Tuesday sweet spot is 2 x 12 with a third rep only if he feels normal, plus a heart-rate stop rule. Week 5 total stays 8.25 h. Week 6 Thursday VO2 starts at 5x3 if he's not fully back.

Calendar now runs day by day to 6 Dec (Base 1 weeks 5-8); Season hours for weeks 5-8 read from it.
